headline: Kai, Monday bought the Jensen Huang comeback with both hands — this morning, futures are quietly asking for a receipt.
subline: Nasdaq futures hand back 1.7% of a 6.5% melt-up, December hike odds reach 95%, and bitcoin is back under $60,000.
asof: Pre-market · as of 6:45 AM ET · every figure links to its source below

items.title: S&P 500 surges 4.7% on Huang reinstatement
items.sentence: The index closed at 7,237.17 and tech's XLK sector gained 9% as Nvidia jumped 31.5%, Micron 19% and CoreWeave 22.3%, per Yahoo Finance.

items.title: Futures fade the best day since April 2025
items.sentence: Nasdaq-100 futures slipped 1.7% and Nvidia about 5% pre-market, per Yahoo Finance, which calls Monday the market's best session since the April 2025 rebound.

items.title: December hike odds hit 95% under Warsh
items.sentence: Traders now price a 95% chance of a quarter-point increase and 5% odds of a half point, per Yahoo Finance, with November Consumer Confidence (92.1 expected) topping today's data.

items.title: Dell, Analog Devices and Best Buy report today
items.sentence: Yahoo Finance's calendar also lists Autodesk, Workday, HP, Medtronic, Dollar Tree and Dick's — the last dense earnings slate before Thursday's holiday.

items.title: Bitcoin slips back under $60,000
items.sentence: CoinDesk puts bitcoin near $59,900 after it handed back Monday's pop to $64,500, with $844 million in leveraged positions liquidated over 24 hours. Spot-ETF outflows ran $569.7 million Monday — a fifth straight session — pushing November to $4.71 billion, the largest monthly outflow on record.

items.title: Newsom commutes more than 540 death sentences
items.sentence: California's governor will commute the sentences of more than 540 condemned inmates, the Everything Briefing reports, drawing condemnation from Trump and a 'selling pardons' retort from Newsom.

items.title: Estonia closes its Russia border December 1
items.sentence: All three road crossings shut after a foiled GRU-linked arson at drone-maker Threod Systems, EU Perspectives reports, giving Estonians two weeks to get home.

items.title: Trump warns of renewed Iran strikes
items.sentence: He may resume strikes after the new year absent a nuclear deal, per the Everything Briefing, as Treasury sanctioned over two dozen Iranian exchange houses in a shadow-banking crackdown.

items.title: Appeals court opens path to erase hush-money conviction
items.sentence: A federal appeals court gave Trump a route to overturning the New York conviction, the Everything Briefing reports, citing AP.

items.title: Mamdani announces permanent closure of Rikers Island
items.sentence: New York's mayor said the jail complex will close for good, per the Everything Briefing, which also notes his clash with Andrew Ross Sorkin over a rent-control question.

items.title: Huang heads to Capitol Hill next week
items.sentence: Fox News reports a closed-door House session December 1 and a public Senate Banking hearing December 3, while Commerce blacklisted Nvidia cloud partner Megaspeed.

items.title: CrowdStrike to buy Zscaler for $43.9 billion
items.sentence: The all-stock deal would be the largest cybersecurity acquisition on record, per Fox News.

items.title: Anthropic slips again in its first trading week
items.sentence: Shares fell 1.4% to $87.64 Monday — a second straight decline since Thursday's IPO — even as the rest of the AI complex ripped, per Fox News.

items.title: Amazon acquires Decart's AI tech for $7.5 billion
items.sentence: The Neuron reports the deal brings Decart's model-optimization research team to Amazon to run AI more efficiently on its Trainium chips.

items.title: OpenAI begins rolling out GPT-6.2 Sol
items.sentence: The update reaches Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise users with gains in complex instruction-following and small visual details, per The Neuron.
